name: Zofia Lewandowska
bio:
Zofia Lewandowska's journey in motorsport began unconventionally. A mathematics prodigy, she initially pursued a career in engineering before a chance encounter at a local rally sparked her passion for racing. She transitioned from designing powertrain components to race strategy, quickly rising through the ranks due to her analytical skills and keen understanding of vehicle dynamics. Zofia believes in empowering her team, fostering a collaborative environment where data-driven insights meet intuitive driver feedback.

At Eurofarma RC, Zofia is known for her meticulous planning and adaptability. She emphasizes rigorous preparation, but also cultivates a culture of quick thinking and decisive action. Her approach blends a deep respect for tradition with an openness to innovative technologies, making her a unique asset in the ever-evolving world of motorsport. She is especially proud of her ability to mentor young engineers and help them find their place in the sport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled bob with a slight wave.
physical.description: A woman of dignified presence, Zofia has a warm smile that belies her sharp intellect.

quirks: Always carries a worn copy of a mathematical textbook.
Insists on starting every race weekend with a traditional Polish breakfast for the team.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
